mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.25%) compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS rising by more than 0.25% in 3 months) signals monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.25pp in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and real consumption (RSAFS) signal a weakening demand cycle, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) falls below 4.0%, indicating a tight labor market, the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates expanding manufacturing output, which correlates with stronger corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when INDPRO is rising.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST falling by more than 5% in one month) signals a weakening housing market, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when HOUST falls > 5% in 1 month.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in employment (PAYEMS) and decreases in unemployment (UNRATE) signal a rapidly tightening labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of periods when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0%, indicating high inflation, the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 3.0%.
